raw_segments.text: I've been coveting this thing for a long while.
It's for you, old man, it's for you.
It belonged to Morozov, it was no use to him.
He had it from his brother.
I swapped a book from father's book case for it, a kinsman of Mahomet or salutary folly,
a scandalous book published in Moscow a hundred years ago before they had any censorship.
And Morozov has a taste for such things.
He was grateful to me, too.
